text:
Maya: Heads-up 5: we should run a final playtest on the new pricing estimator + FAQ copy. Objective: fewer 'how do you calculate' CS tickets, and surface webinar for teams >$3k/mo. Launch window Wed.

Jon: Agree. Suggest we also track UI friction via heatmap for the embed calc. Small change: move CTA under the line item summary.

Ravi: A/B idea: two CTA colors and two microcopy versions. Copy A: 'Estimate monthly cost' Copy B: 'Show commitment savings'. Color A: #0066FF (primary), Color B: #00A86B (green). Measure clicks -> webinar signups.

Elena: For GDPR/EU customers we should show a tooltip: "Data stays in your region for estimates". Also flag that committed discounts shown are illustrative.

Priya: Routing rules proposal: projected_mrr >= 3000 -> tag:calc_highvalue + notify sales@redwood.ai; 1000-2999 -> tag:calc_mid (auto invite to webinar); <1000 -> tag:calc_low (nurture). Use HubSpot lifecycle stage mapping. I'll draft handoff doc.

ops-bot: Created routing rule id=rc-9012. Conditions: projected_mrr >= 3000 -> tag:calc_highvalue; 1000-2999 -> tag:calc_mid; <1000 -> tag:calc_low. Webhook -> hubspot.endpoint/v1/lead-route.

Maya: Nice. Add analytics events: estimator_open, estimator_submit, projected_mrr, cta_color, cta_copy, webinar_modal_shown. Also add funnel metric: calc_to_webinar_pct.

Jon: I'll wire heatmap + click tracking. Please expose data layer event `pricing_estimator.ready` so we can test in staging.

Ravi: Optimizely config: 50/50 by CTA copy, add secondary split for color (2x2 factorial). Early stop rules: min N=1000 impressions or p<0.005. Success metric: webinar_registration or AE_contacted.

Elena: Copy for FAQ accordion item: "How we estimate costs" -> "We multiply your input throughput by model cost per token, add reserved capacity SLO buffer, and apply illustrative volume discounts. Use it as a planning tool, not an invoice." Add link to /docs/pricing-estimates.

Zoe: Quick UX ask: when projected_mrr > 1500 show a subtle line: 'Saving tips' with 3 bullets (batching, KV cache, quantize). Link those to Optimize docs.

Maya: Good. Priya when you have the handoff, include sample HubSpot lists and the email drip content for calc_mid. Also we need a short benchmark blurb for the webinar landing: one sentence + 2 bullets.

Priya: Will do. Draft landing copy: "How teams cut inference spend while keeping latency - live demo + Q&A." Bullets: "3 customer wins (2.5x cost reduction); Best practices for batching & caching."

ops-bot: Reminder set: pricing-estimator-playtest 2026-03-25T09:30:00-07:00.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Quick 20m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to validate events and routing. After that we push to staging for QA. :rocket:
